content: Flutter Linux packaging 2026: fastforge 0.6.12 (2026-07-29) is the maintained successor to flutter_distributor (0.6.10, marked discontinued on pub.dev) and builds deb/rpm/AppImage/zip from a release bundle. Flatpak tooling for Flutter is community-maintained: TheAppgineer/flatpak-flutter (pre-processor for offline builds) and o-murphy/flutpak. Packaging materially changes portal identity: xdg-desktop-portal derives an unsandboxed app's id from the systemd unit name (app-*.scope) and yields an empty id for dbus-activated or terminal-launched processes; org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry.Register(app_id, options) lets an unsandboxed app declare its id, but only once, only before any other portal call, and only if it is NOT detected as sandboxed. Under Flatpak the id comes from $FLATPAK_ID and the Registry call must be removed. GlobalShortcuts is at interface version 2 (CreateSession, BindShortcuts, ListShortcuts, ConfigureShortcuts + Activated/Deactivated/ShortcutsChanged); persistence is keyed by application identity, and the app id must match an installed .desktop basename.
